definitions.explanation: An orbit shaped like a circle, in which a body keeps a roughly constant distance from the object it orbits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{円軌道|えんきどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The satellite traces a circular orbit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}→人工衛星：11715_jinkoueisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{円軌道|えんきどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧。
examples.english: To put an artificial satellite into a circular orbit.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧{円軌道|えんきどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}っている→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: This planet moves around the sun in a nearly circular orbit.

notes:
USAGE: {円軌道|えんきどう} is a circular orbit, contrasted with an elliptical one. It combines ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (circle) with ⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧ (orbit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {円軌道|えんきどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to trace a circular orbit
- {円軌道|えんきどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧: to place into a circular orbit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楕円軌道|だえんきどう}→楕円軌道：29618_daenkidou⟧: elliptical orbit — the distance varies
- ⟦{静止軌道|せいしきどう}→静止軌道：29619_seishikidou⟧: geostationary orbit
